reason: The README clearly describes a session-memory plugin that distills completed conversations into durable Markdown entries and exposes them as model skills, making memory-context the primary category.

summaries.zh: 该插件会将已完成会话中的问题、回答和工具调用提炼为持久化记忆条目，并以记忆技能形式提供给模型使用。
summaries.en: This plugin distills completed session content into durable memory entries and exposes them to the model as memory skills.

capabilities: Reads completed turn questions, answers, and tool calls
Sends distilled turn content to an auxiliary model call
Stores durable Markdown memory entries and an index on disk
Registers dynamically generated memory skills for model access
Appends memory-related session events and logs
